common: Use case: ui-mockup. Input image 1 is the edit target and strict visual/content reference: the real ServicePilot light Chinese Streamlit customer-service page. Produce ONE professional desktop design-option screenshot, 16:10 landscape, high resolution. This is a CONCEPT preview, not a newly implemented website. Main request: reduce excessive vertical whitespace in the TOP BRAND/NAVIGATION HEADER and make the header-to-body transition feel coherent. Keep the existing forest-green, white and pale gray-green palette, same typography, same main content width, same relative two-column chat/execution arrangement and all existing body content and controls. Only compress/reorganize the top brand/navigation surface as specified by the individual option, and move the entire unchanged body upward accordingly. Do not redesign the body, chat card, blue notice, execution card, input or reset button. Do not add a hero illustration, marketing slogan, KPI cards, sidebar, dark theme, gradient, floating header panel, thick shadow or new business functions. Header background MUST span the entire viewport width, not become a centered rounded floating panel. Preserve a distinct ~40px top Streamlit platform-control safe area, with small Share/star/edit controls at right, with no overlapping logo or tabs. Crop away browser tabs, browser address bar and Windows taskbar; render the app area only, at normal reading scale. Add only a small neutral comparison label ABOVE the app mockup, explicitly marked 效果预览; that label is not an application feature. Keep four tabs in exactly this order: 客服体验 / 架构总览 / 项目介绍 / 代码解读; 客服体验 remains selected with green underline. Keep brand text ServicePilot and subtitle 模拟电商售后 · Agent 工作流, green S logo, and badge 模拟业务 Demo. Keep body title 让订单与规则查询有依据。, button 新会话, description 查询演示订单，或了解模拟退货申请规则。, blue notice 仅使用演示订单与模拟政策。退货申请需人工审核，本 Demo 不直接执行退款。, chat empty-state 今天想了解什么？, examples 查一下 A1001 and 了解退货规则, input 输入订单或售后问题..., and execution title 执行记录. Maintain the remaining screenshot body text as closely as possible. No dates or self-test questions or personal mastery caveats. Use readable Simplified Chinese, precise clean UI geometry. Do not substitute body text from other projects. The top header should feel like the SAME app with improved density, not a different visual identity.

options.name: 紧凑双行顶栏
options.prompt: Comparison label exactly: 方案 A｜紧凑双行顶栏 · 效果预览. RECOMMENDED CONSERVATIVE OPTION. Preserve the original TWO-ROW app header structure. Beneath the ~40px platform safe row, a compact ~56px brand row contains S logo and ServicePilot at left, Demo badge at right, both aligned to existing body content edges. Directly beneath it, a ~44px navigation row contains the four tabs left aligned. Remove the large empty band between logo and tabs. White full-bleed brand+nav surface; a single hairline pale gray-green bottom divider. Body begins ~20–24px below navigation. Keep the original body modules and internal spacing intact. Visually this is a careful reduction of header vertical padding and row gaps, the least structural change of the three options. Crisp white header flows cleanly into the existing pale gray-green body. Do not introduce a tinted header.

options.name: 单行工作台顶栏
options.prompt: Comparison label exactly: 方案 B｜单行工作台顶栏 · 效果预览. DENSE WORKBENCH OPTION. Preserve the ~40px platform safe row. Beneath it, combine brand and four desktop tabs into ONE ~76px full-width white header row. At the left of the centered existing body width: green S logo and compact two-line ServicePilot/subtitle. To its right in the SAME ROW: the four existing tabs, same order and green underline for 客服体验. Small Demo badge aligned at the far right. Use sufficient horizontal gaps to avoid crowding; do not hide subtitle or controls. A single thin bottom divider. Body starts ~24px below this row, moving the original body higher than in option A. Keep every body module, two columns, content width and internal spacing unchanged. This option should visibly provide the most vertical working space while retaining the app's existing calm white/green identity. Do not add a second navigation row.

options.name: 浅色过渡顶栏
options.prompt: Comparison label exactly: 方案 C｜浅色过渡顶栏 · 效果预览. SOFTER TRANSITION OPTION. Preserve the ~40px white platform-control safe area. Preserve TWO-ROW brand/navigation structure and existing left/right alignment, with a compact ~64px brand row and ~44px tabs row. The full-bleed BRAND ROW uses a very pale desaturated gray-green surface #edf3ef; keep S logo, subtitle and Demo badge. Navigation row uses the existing body pale gray-green #f5f7f6 rather than a harsh white band, selected tab retains its green underline. Use one subtle thin divider between rows. No gradient, no card-like outer rounded header, no decorative illustration. Body begins ~20px below tabs on the SAME pale gray-green surface, visually blending navigation and body. Retain slightly more breathing room than A, but remove the original excessive empty white area. This option differs through background continuity, not a new palette or a body redesign. Original chat and event panels stay exactly as in reference.
